description: Which type names does a PARAMETERS declaration accept, with which Parameters Type and QueryDef.Fields Type/Size of the output (SELECT pX AS v FROM ONE), and with which error number where refused? Names: Bit; Byte; Short; Long; Currency; IEEESingle; IEEEDouble; DateTime; Text; Text ( 10 ); LongText; LongBinary; Binary; Binary ( 4 ); Guid; Decimal; Decimal ( 10, 2 ); Value; Integer; Single; Double; Float; Real; Memo; Counter; Date; Boolean; YesNo; Numeric; Char; VarChar ( 5 ); BigInt; Variant; Object; OLEObject; TinyInt; SmallInt; Int; Money. For each temporary QueryDef the Parameters (Name, Type, Direction) and Fields (Name, Type, Size) are read; no value is assigned and nothing is opened. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text goes into a temporary QueryDef (CreateQueryDef with an empty name, then DBEngine.Errors).
